assumptions.choice: Track long_setup and short_setup state flags when RSI breaches lower/upper bands and reset upon trade entry
assumptions.reason: The specification requires entering long when RSI falls below the lower band AND THEN crosses above RSI_SMA20 (and vice versa for short), requiring state memory between band breach and crossover.

assumptions.choice: Place a stop order in notify_order using actual executed entry price, and cancel it when an RSI crossover exit signal occurs
assumptions.reason: The exact entry price is only known upon order completion in backtrader, ensuring accurate 2% stop price placement and clean position exit management.
